key_requirements: Data protection standards, controller registration with OIC, data subject rights
retention_period: As long as necessary for the purpose
penalties_range: Up to 4% of annual gross worldwide turnover (bodies corporate)
exemptions: Domestic use; national security; journalism & artistic purposes
deceased_data: Protected until 30 years after death: personal data includes data on individuals deceased for less than 30 years (s. 2)
research_exemption: Exemption for processing for research, statistical and historical purposes where results do not identify individuals (Part V exemptions; section not confirmed) (unconfirmed)
genetic_data: Sensitive personal data includes genetic data and biometric data; stricter processing conditions apply
notes: OIC set up Dec 2021; controller duties from 2023-12-01; full enforcement expected only by 2028
